init_diffusion_llm: initialize the DLLM manager and configuration for Diffusion LLM scheduling
get_new_batch_dllm: generate a new DLLM batch from waiting and staging queues for scheduling
process_batch_result_dllm: process batch generation results including token allocation and cache release
create_dllm_manager: create a DllmManager instance to manage waiting and staging queues for Diffusion LLM requests
process_dllm_staging_reqs: process staging DLLM requests with resource allocation and preemption support
